D/ DN VALENTI NIANVS PF AVG ; R/ GLORIARO MANORVM

Copper alloy Coin. Nummus of Valentinian I (364-375), Gloria Romanorum issue of 364-375, Reece period 19, Siscia mint. Obverse description: Bust diademed and cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: DN VALENTI NIANVS PF AVG. Reverse description: Emperor advancing right holding labarum and dragging captive. Reverse inscription: GLORIARO MANORVM. In exergue: [delta]SIS.
